item.title: How to get the current month in JavaScript
item.description: Getting the current month is crucial for date filtering, monthly reports, and seasonal functionality in web applications. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve implemented month extraction in numerous calendar components, analytics dashboards, and date picker widgets. From my expertise, the most important consideration is understanding that getMonth() returns zero-based values (0-11). This method requires careful handling to match standard month numbering expectations in user interfaces.
